preconditions.description: The length of the text string txt must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of the pattern string pat must be at least 1 and less than the length of txt.
Both txt and pat must be strings.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ' '.join(map(str, result)) if result else stdout == '-1'
postconditions.description: The output must be the 1-based indices of occurrences of pat in txt, or -1 if no occurrences are found.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= len(txt) for index in result)
postconditions.description: All returned indices must be valid 1-based indices within the bounds of txt.

postconditions.expression: len(result) == sum(1 for i in range(len(txt) - len(pat) + 1) if txt[i:i+len(pat)] == pat)
postconditions.description: The number of returned indices must match the number of occurrences of pat in txt.
